later_events.mechanism: further_exemption_by_new_order: Executive Order 12056 (signed 1978-04-28) is a later order that recites this order and grants the same person a further exemption from mandatory retirement; it neither revokes, amends nor shortens this order.

clauses.reason: The order exempts G. Joseph Minetti, Member of the Civil Aeronautics Board, from mandatory retirement for age under subsection (c) of section 8335 of title 5 of the United States Code until May 1, 1978. The order recites his earlier exemptions through January 31, 1978 under Executive Orders No. 12006, No. 12011 and No. 12016, earlier orders that are not later events for this order. The order is a single command with one fixed term, so its own stated date is the first end: 1978-05-01, recorded inclusive (the exemption runs through the end of that day); the exclusive reading, under which it ends when that day begins, is 1978-04-30. The order was signed 1978-01-31. Later events: Executive Order 12056 of 1978-04-28, each a further exemption of the same person with its own term, recorded as a later event and not as an end of this order. No amendment, revocation or shortening of this order is held (searched below).

research_rationale:
EO 12037 (signed 1978-01-31) is a one-person exemption under section 8335(c) of title 5, United States Code: G. Joseph Minetti, Member of the Civil Aeronautics Board, is exempted from mandatory retirement for age until May 1, 1978. The held Federal Register text of the order was read in full and is a single operative clause (the recital, the finding of public interest, and the exempting sentence). The order ends by its own terms on 1978-05-01 (inclusive; exclusive alternative 1978-04-30, owner ruling 2026-10-21 on until dates). Later events: Executive Order 12056 of 1978-04-28, each a further exemption of the same person with its own term, recorded as a later event and not as an end of this order. Searches judged adequate: U.S. Code and eCFR (no hit naming the order), the Office of the Federal Register disposition-note catalog, and the held-text search for the person's full name, which found the chain members recorded above and nothing else. Whether the person left office on or before the stated date is not in any held source and is not asserted.

savings.reason: The exemption only suspended compulsory retirement for the stated term; it creates no continuing duty, office or rule. The person's service during the term and the pay for it had accrued by 1978-05-01; nothing in the order survives that date, and any later exemption is a separate grant recorded as a later event.
